message.text:
This confirms it clearly. This is the [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) repo.

h03.

The provider abstraction lives in the `internal/idp` package (`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`), which defines the generic `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type used across identity-provider integrations (`internal/idp/idp.go`). The concrete protocol implementation that ships is the `internal/idp/oauth2` package (`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`), whose doc comment states "Package oauth2 implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration" and provides the `IdentityProvider` type with `NewIdentityProvider`/`ExchangeToken` methods built on `golang.org/x/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`, lines 1-22).

**Answer: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`; `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`**
